responses.text: Thank you! They were going to kill me!
Don't worry, I'll stay out of trouble from now on. Honest.
There won't be a next time. I hope.

topics.prompt: You were lucky. I might not be around next time.

responses.text: I... may have overheard some things at Gomorrah that I passed on to the NCR. That's all! Honest.

topics.prompt: Why were the Omertas out to kill you?
Save your thanks - this was a job, nothing more.

responses.text: {slightly insulted} What? I only talk to Captain Curtis over at McCarran. I would never work with slavers. Honest.

topics.prompt: You work with the NCR? It was the Legion who sent me to protect you.

responses.text: No! Well, not really. I mean, I'm not listening through doors or sneaking around or anything. People talk out loud, and I just pay attention.
The NCR likes to keep tabs on the activities of the families, and they pay me good caps to hang around the casinos and keep my ears open.
It isn't normally. The NCR wanted me to just gamble and listen, nothing else.

topics.prompt: Let's talk about something else now.

responses.text: I do odd jobs here and there, usually helping Sarah keep the Vault tidy. I came to New Vegas to be a professional gambler.
Too bad for me that the "professional" part isn't working out so good. But, I love gambling, so I'm here to stay on the Strip until they kick me out.
